name: anna
description: Anna — an always-on AI companion who lives at the edge of your screen.
author: Zicheng Zhao

scripts.dist:mac: npm run fetch:character && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --publish never

extendInfo.NSCameraUsageDescription: Anna looks up to see how you are doing. The camera is off until you turn it on, and frames are never stored.
extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Anna listens so she can answer you out loud.
extendInfo.NSCalendarsUsageDescription: Anna reads your calendar so she knows what your day looks like.
extendInfo.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: Anna transcribes your speech so she can reply.
extendInfo.NSAppleEventsUsageDescription: Anna asks the system which app you are in, and your calendar what is coming up. She never sends keystrokes or controls other apps.
